versions.changelog:
- Bumped version to 1.0.2.
- Documentation or metadata updates; no user-facing feature changes.

- Updated supported models list to include new video generation models (Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling V3, and more).
- Removed previously listed models that are no longer supported.
- Example usage updated to reflect new model options.

Initial release of lrshuAI-image-to-video.

- Generates videos from a single image and text description using multiple supported models.
- Supports popular video generation models including Doubao PixelDance, OpenAI Sora, Luma Ray, Kling, Jimeng, and Vidu.
- Direct invocation required using `python script/invoke_model.py`; do not use `openclaw run`.
- Requires `TEAM_API_KEY` environment variable.
